responsibility: Implements the RTL stack-adjustment combiner pass that tracks explicit stack pointer updates and intervening stack references in each basic block in order to fold multiple stack adjustments together or propagate an adjustment across stack-based MEM operands. It is specialized to stack-pointer arithmetic, CFA notes, push/pre-modify forms, and outgoing-argument related notes, using DF simulation to maintain liveness while deleting or rewriting stack-adjusting insns; this functionality is exposed as the "csa" pass rather than being part of the general combiner.
